stories.title: Sailors report shortages, desperation aboard USS Abraham Lincoln; officials dismiss concerns
new_facts: Wife of sailor who went overboard is now speaking out with disturbing details about the incident.
Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth publicly called reports of USS Abraham Lincoln conditions 'completely misrepresented'.
A replacement aircraft carrier is heading to the Middle East to relieve USS Abraham Lincoln.
USS George Washington named as the specific replacement carrier being sent to relieve the Lincoln.
Lincoln's deployment had been expected to end in May but was extended with no current return date.
Sailor texts reveal food shortages (no milk 3 months, rotten meat) on USS Abraham Lincoln deployed since November.
Multiple sailors attempted to go overboard on USS Abraham Lincoln during 9-month Middle East deployment.
Senate Democrats specifically (not just unnamed congressional lawmakers) are demanding answers about Lincoln conditions.
stories.line: Sailors aboard USS Abraham Lincoln report severe supply shortages and deteriorating conditions during extended Middle East deployment; some reportedly attempted to leave the ship.

stories.title: Kennedy Center board votes to close for renovations, add Trump's name back
new_facts: Kennedy Center board voted to add Trump's name to facade, circumventing judge's removal order, potentially setting new legal fight.
Inscription would read 'Restored and Renovated by President Donald [Trump]', placed beneath existing Kennedy Center signage; board also voted partial closure for two-year overhaul.
Center has until next week to present renovation and naming plan to the federal judge who blocked earlier efforts.
Leavitt departure comes less than 3 months before midterms; Trump approval hits record low per YouGov.
Renovation cost is $250 million; federal judge had temporarily blocked a similar closure three months ago.
stories.line: Kennedy Center board votes to close for renovations and reinscribe Trump's name on the building.

stories.line: Ukraine strikes Russian oil infrastructure and business assets deep inside Russia; analysts debate whether damage pressures Moscow's war economy.

new_facts: White House to host crypto and prediction market executives next Wednesday.
DOJ memo extending executive privilege to 'private advisers' issued two days before Leavitt announced outside adviser role, raising questions about timing.
Leavitt's resignation left Trump with no plan to replace her; top officials will cover briefings in interim.
Leavitt's departure stunned many insiders; no successor plan in place; multiple names being floated.
stories.line: White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt is resigning this month; Trump has no announced replacement yet.
